status_measured: open: delegation.md has no tier section; DL-8, DL-12 and surfaces.mcp.auth 'delegation' read as unconditional
proposed_fix: a trust-tier section: a callee MUST NOT require a token from a T0/T1 caller, MAY accept and verify one for attribution and narrowing; DL-8 scoped to T2; DL-12's retirement of descriptor-token calls applies across the machine boundary; auth 'delegation' is for a service exposed to T2; T0 = loopback on the owner's OS account, T1 = an enrolled machine's binding (RM-21 decides it), else T2; 'loopback reachability is not authorization' stays a statement about hostile local processes; amendment 4 keeps 'no call with another service's descriptor token' as attribution hygiene, not a local requirement, and 'never spend another agent's key or vault slot' in force (money)
